notes.title: Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2 Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi!
All rewards, achievements, and the full Steam setup for Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2 are already complete. With the final content wrapped up, we’re now heading into the last stretch before release.[/p][p]And I know many of you have been waiting for the exact date. So let’s not keep it a mystery any longer.

Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2 will release on:
[b]October 30th, 2025.[/b] 

Mark your calendars and get ready.[/p][p]Ahead of launch, there will also be a small patch for Season 1 to make the transition into Season 2 smoother and more convenient for everyone.[/p][p]In the meantime, I’m focused on spreading the word and gathering more wishlists. Season 2 has already climbed into the top 3800 on Steam, which is a big milestone for me. I didn’t expect that, and I’m truly grateful to everyone who’s shown support. It means a lot to know so many of you are looking forward to what’s next.[/p][p]Here are a few preview renders from the final episode of Season 2. You won’t find these on the store page. It’s just a little something extra for those of you keeping up with the journey.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2 is now 95% complete!
notes.notes:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44793446/2f40d742ac44e915e565c1b1625da8d9abb3b655.png"][/img]
Hi![/p][p]After 14 months of development, I’m excited to share that Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2 is now 95% complete! 
The final update alone adds a whopping 1260 static renders and 112 animations—easily the biggest and most action-packed content drop in the season. I think you're going to love it.[/p][p]So, why 95% and not 100%?[/p][p]All the core story content is done—renders, animations, music, and SFX are fully wrapped. What’s left is adding some extra goodies like Phone Rewards and FullHD render unlocks. It’s also the perfect time to ramp up visibility and gather more wishlists. The numbers are already higher than Season 1 (which is great!), but these final months before release are crucial to giving Season 2 the strong start it deserves.[/p][p]And yes—Season 3 is already on my mind. Season 2 laid the groundwork, setting the stage for what I hope will be a strong, satisfying final chapter.[/p][p]Leading up to the October release, I’ll be sharing a few preview renders here—especially from the big finale. The characters look absolutely stunning, and it’d be a shame if you didn’t get a sneak peek.[/p][p]That’s all for now—back to work I go![/p][p]Take care![/p]

notes.title: Cybernetic Seduction - Season 2 is now 80% complete!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44793446/ed6cf2968b0c4cafe8c94e2f370cfb2c32de8029.jpg[/img]
Hi!
Good news! Cybernetic Seduction - Season 2 is now 80% complete!

The second-to-last episode is finished, adding 830 renders and over 60 animations to an already massive season. And it’s not over yet — the final episode is still ahead, and it’s shaping up to be the biggest, wildest, most action-packed chapter yet.

All major storylines are now in place, setting the stage for the Season 2 finale. Everything’s been building to this, and now it’s time for the payoff.

Looking ahead, Season 3 will wrap up the story. There’s still plenty to explore, but the Season 2 finale sets the stage in a big way. 
The release date remains October 2025, and I’m on track to deliver all episodes within that timeframe. 

In the meantime, wishlists are climbing steadily — well ahead of where things were during Season 1 — so thanks for helping spread the word! 

Take care!

notes.title: Wishlist Cybernetic Seduction - Season 2!
notes.notes:
Hi!
I’m pleased to share a fresh update on Cybernetic Seduction – Season 2: with the latest progress, we are now at 60% completion, bringing me one step closer to the official Steam launch. 
Better yet, the Season 2 Steam page is approved and live, so I invite you to head over and wishlist the DLC today. Follow this link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3552650/Cybernetic_Seduction__Season_2/

The more wishlists at launch, the bigger the impact, so let’s make it happen! Time to crank those numbers up!
Check out the two brand-new trailers (one fun trailer and one story trailer), along with over 30 screenshots, all showcasing the major leaps I’ve made in visual quality, as well as new scenes and all the hot characters we know and love. If you enjoyed Season 1, you’ll see I’ve poured a lot of care into making this next installment even better—faster-paced, with much more action and ‘action.’ Improvements across the board, from the art quality to the storyline itself.
Though there’s still work to do, I’m committed to keeping up the pace until Season 2 is fully completed—and that’s this year.
As a heads-up, Season 3 will be the final chapter of Cybernetic Seduction, and it will also release as DLC.

Enjoy the new trailers, take a peek at the screenshots, and stay tuned for more updates!

Take care!

notes.title: Cybernetic Seduction Season 2 is now 40% complete!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/vV4h16Q/Ep5-Heist-Office-FV-1-14-1.png[/img]

Hi!
I'm thrilled to share some fantastic news with you all! I am now 40% through the development of Cybernetic Seduction Season 2. It's been a busy period, but incredibly rewarding. I've already completed two massive episodes. The first episode boasts 800 renders and 75 animations, and the second ramps it up with 1100 renders and 100 animations!

There's still plenty to do, but I am 100% confident that I'll have the entire season ready for you in 2025. And if everything goes according to plan, I'll dive right into producing the third and final season for a 2026 release. It's going to be an epic conclusion!

I'll keep the updates coming as each new episode is polished and ready. You can expect to stay in the loop with regular posts here. Also, keep an eye out in January when I plan to launch the Steam page for Season 2!

I want to take a moment to express my gratitude to all of you. Your support by purchasing and playing my games truly means the world to me. It's your enthusiasm and engagement that make all of this possible. So, from the bottom of my heart, thank you so much.

Take care!

notes.title: Season 2 is now 15% complete!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/XLf5xL2/Ep5-K-1-12-1.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone!

I'm excited to share that Cybernetic Seduction Season 2 is now 15% complete! I'm pushing full steam ahead with no breaks, doing everything I can to deliver a satisfying sequel as quickly as possible. There's still a long journey ahead, but I'll make sure to keep you updated at every significant progress point so you always know what's happening.

On the localization front, I am currently working on the Simplified Chinese translation. It’s still a ways off, but I'll upload it as soon as it’s ready to go. I’m also planning to explore additional language options down the line.

I've noticed some questions popping up about Season 2, so here are some clarifications:
[b]Save Compatibility:[/b] Yes, all saves from Season 1 will be compatible with Season 2, allowing you to continue your journey seamlessly.
[b]Future Seasons:[/b] The plan includes three seasons in total. Season 2 will be around the same size or slightly larger than the first, while Season 3 will be shorter and cheaper, designed to wrap up the story. All crucial events are already mapped out.

Lastly, I want to extend a heartfelt thank you for your incredible support. Your enthusiasm and very positive reviews have been incredibly motivating and keep me driven to do my best work. I'm grateful for every copy purchased and every word of encouragement received.

Take care!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Kendra!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/RYBrdtT/Kendra-Intro-1-1-1.png[/img]
Hi everyone!
I'm thrilled to be back with another post in my character introduction series. Today, we're getting up close and personal with Kendra, Lilith's pride and joy.

Kendra, embodying the epitome of youth and innocence, is confirmed to be 18+. While acing her studies at the University of Zhine, Kendra is still on a real journey of self-discovery. What is her path?
The pressure from her parents to take up the family's legacy keeps mounting. But Kendra's spirit is too gentle, too kind-hearted for that world.

Enter you, the Agent. In a world that often seems unforgiving, Kendra finds herself drawn to your character's multifaceted personality. Merely a bodyguard? A soldier? Or could you be something more? This connection presents you with a crucial choice: Will you guide Kendra towards discovering her authentic self, or will you use this connection to curry favor with Lilith?
Kendra's journey, and perhaps her heart, depends on the path you choose.

Good luck, Agent!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Lilith!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/5k0PC9C/Lilith-Intro-1-1-1.png[/img]

Welcome, Everyone!
I'm absolutely thrilled to make my very first post here and share something I'm super excited about: a series of posts introducing you to the cast of characters in Cybernetic Seduction - Season 1! First up on the roster is the one and only Lilith!

In Cybernetic Seduction, you step into the shoes of Agent Cock, a role that demands both charm and strategy, tasked with the ultimate seduction mission: getting close to the key women in Hector Zhine's life. And trust me, it's no walk in the park, especially when it comes to Lilith. She's known for her resourcefulness, her strictness, and her demanding nature. But is that tough exterior all there is to her, or does she have a softer side, perhaps for her daughter, Kendra?

Infiltrate the dynamics of her relationship with Hector. Rumor has it, it's anything but warm. Become Lilith's confidante, earn her trust, and find a path to her heart.

Stay tuned for more character reveals in the coming weeks!

Take care!
